ownerStatement: Ja, Filip, kao owner Lumen beta testiranja i provider/XUI pristupa, potvrđujem da je isti account/upstream dozvoljen za kontrolisani beta test do 300-500 korisnika. Potvrđujem da beta ne sme koristiti XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround bez moje eksplicitne odluke. U slučaju 401/403/429/5xx eskalacije, playback regresije ili provider overload-a, ja sam decision owner za stop/throttle/rollback.

target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

mediaPath.evidence: output/playwright/manual-network-audit/REPORT.md; pnpm release:no-media-evidence:scan -- output/playwright/manual-network-audit/report.json; artifacts/release/media-policy/qaf035-no-media-evidence-scan-20260602.json; artifacts/release/compatibility/qaf035-provider-local-20260602.json; pnpm --filter @lumen/web exec vitest run src/components/player/catchupGateway.test.ts src/components/player/catchupSource.test.ts

localEdgeSmoke.scope: Local QA server smoke for prepared web/proxy endpoints only; not deployed edge/load evidence and not a substitute for 300-500 live-user beta capacity proof.
localEdgeSmoke.notes: Smoke used no browser automation and did not request provider media streams. Keep lumen-edge-capacity pending until deployed web/proxy sizing or load evidence is recorded.

httpsStagingEdgeSmoke.scope: Ephemeral HTTPS staging tunnel smoke for static app, manifest, Cast receiver, and proxy health endpoints only; not deployed edge/load evidence and not a substitute for 300-500 live-user beta capacity proof.
httpsStagingEdgeSmoke.notes: Smoke used no browser automation and did not request provider media streams. Keep lumen-edge-capacity pending until deployed web/proxy edge sizing or 300-500 live-user load evidence is recorded.

deployedEdgeLoadEvidence.scope: Pending deployed Lumen web/proxy edge load proof for 300-500 beta users with no provider media streams. This must cover the deployed app/proxy edge and is not satisfied by localEdgeSmoke or httpsStagingEdgeSmoke.
deployedEdgeLoadEvidence.notes: Pending final deployed capacity evidence. Keep lumen-edge-capacity and capacity signoff pending until the deployed 500-concurrent-user edge/load report is recorded.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner confirms the QA/beta account and upstream service can support the planned 300-500 live-user beta without adding XUI-side transcode/remux.
checks.notes: Filip owner signoff approves the same provider/XUI account and upstream for a controlled 300-500-user beta and forbids XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround without explicit owner decision.

checks.description: Lumen web/proxy path capacity is sized for the beta cohort and does not perform per-user media processing.
checks.evidence: artifacts/release/performance/qaf035-performance-evidence-20260603.json; artifacts/release/media-policy/qaf035-runtime-media-policy-20260602.json; localEdgeSmoke in this artifact; httpsStagingEdgeSmoke in this artifact; deployedEdgeLoadEvidence pending in this artifact; output/perf/staging-capacity-smoke/REPORT.md
checks.notes: Owner is recorded, runtime media policy proves no per-user media processing, and local plus HTTPS staging web/proxy smoke passed. Keep pending until deployedEdgeLoadEvidence records explicit 300-500 beta sizing/load evidence for the deployed Lumen web/proxy path.

checks.description: Browser/network/process evidence shows catch-up failures are handled with provider bytes, normalized manifests, or unsupported overlays, not ffmpeg/remux/transcode/generated HLS.
checks.notes: Manual browser/network audit captured 0 disallowed media-processing URL hits and 0 media-processing processes. The no-media evidence scanner also passed against the captured audit report and would fail on remux/transcode/ffmpeg/ffprobe/generated-HLS/XUI-side evidence. Compatibility artifact has provider/no-media/gateway slices passing and device slices still pending. Runtime media policy now also proves static and tested proxy/remux-controller guards reject remux even when env/debug inputs try to allow it.

checks.description: Beta launch has monitored startup, playback failure, provider error, and no-media-processing signals with named owner response.
checks.notes: Minimal beta ops setup is recorded: Filip owner, manual alert channel, daily beta report/log export, and 30-minute beta-blocker response SLO.

checks.description: Rollback or enrollment throttle plan is approved for provider overload, playback regressions, or capacity breach.
checks.notes: Stop/throttle/rollback owner, notification route, decision authority, and no-media-processing stop trigger are recorded in beta ops signoff.

signoff.notes: Provider/XUI owner capacity approval, no-media verification, observability SLO, and rollback/throttle ownership are recorded. Overall capacity signoff stays pending until deployed Lumen edge capacity/load evidence is recorded.
